name: techsentinals-crm
description: TechSentinals LLP internal CRM — leads, clients, projects, change requests, quotes, invoices, finance, vault

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
